children: TransCode Therapeutics named John Tattory the company's interim chief financial officer, effective immediately.
He succeeds Tom Fitzgerald, who has been CFO since 2018, TransCode said Thursday.

Tattory is currently a managing director at global the advisory firm of Stout Risius Ross. He previously worked at Ernst & Young, and as a finance director at Bristol-Myers Squibb and Tyco International. He was also CFO for Cerapedics and Windtree Therapeutics, the TransCode said.
Fitzgerald will resign as CFO and as a director effective immediately, and will continue to provide transition services to the company, the company added.
TransCode describes itself as an immuno-oncology and targeted cancer therapy company with a focus on treating advanced malignancy.
